subject: Planned sunsetting of LogStream — subprocessor update & impact summary
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Donna Park <donna.park@cloudedge.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Jul 2029 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Planned sunsetting of LogStream — subprocessor update & impact summary

Hi Donna,

Quick heads-up: we plan to decommission our current log/transit processor, LogStream Inc., in the EU routing path and replace it with a new partner, EdgeBridge Ltd. This change is targeted for the week of Aug 12 — the main driver is throughput and improved support for customer-controlled KMS.

What this means for CloudEdge:
- Data residency: your EU-region ingests will continue to be routed to EU nodes. EdgeBridge will process transit-only logs (no model inputs stored beyond transit), and we will maintain the same retention controls you already have configured.
- Encryption & keys: EdgeBridge supports bring-your-own-KMS. We will continue to use customer-managed keys for any persisted artifacts.
- Contracts & evidence: we have attached our updated subprocessor inventory and a short impact summary. We will provide SOC 2 and dataflow diagrams from EdgeBridge before the migration.

Ask: please review the attached subprocessor inventory (subprocessor-inventory-20290701.csv) and confirm any concerns by Friday, Jul 5. If you need a DPA amendment before go-live, we can prepare a redlined draft.

If helpful, I can set up a 30-minute call with EdgeBridge and our security team next week.

Thanks,
Marissa
-----
Marissa Cole
Account Lead, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments: subprocessor-inventory-20290701.csv (CSV listing processors, regions, roles)

From: Donna Park <donna.park@cloudedge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: legal@cloudedge.com
Date: Mon, 01 Jul 2029 12:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Planned sunsetting of LogStream — subprocessor update & impact summary

Hi Marissa — thanks for the note. A few immediate questions: 

1) Is EdgeBridge located or incorporated outside the EEA? If so, please confirm the transfer mechanism you will use (SCCs, BCRs, or standard contractual clauses) and whether EdgeBridge is willing to accept SCCs.
2) Can you confirm what data elements are passed to EdgeBridge during transit (IPs, timestamps, full payloads)? We need clarity for our privacy team.
3) We will need to see EdgeBridge's most recent SOC 2 Type II report and the redlined DPA amendment before we approve the switch.

Also: please send us a rollback plan and the expected window of potential double-routing (if any) so we can validate against our compliance schedule.

Donna Park
Head of Platform Security
CloudEdge Solutions
donna.park@cloudedge.com

On behalf of: legal@cloudedge.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Donna Park <donna.park@cloudedge.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Jul 2029 08:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Planned sunsetting of LogStream — subprocessor update & impact summary

Hi Donna — quick answers inline and attached artifacts: see edgebridge-dataflow-diagram.pdf and a draft DPA amendment (dpa-amendment-draft.docx).

1) Jurisdiction: EdgeBridge Ltd is incorporated in Ireland and operates EU data centers. No transfers to the US are planned for EU-region traffic.

2) Data elements: EdgeBridge processes transit metadata (source IP, timestamp, routing headers) and encrypted payloads for routing only. Payloads are not persisted beyond transient buffering except in the event of a failover; buffering retention is capped at 24 hours and subject to your retention configuration.

3) Evidence: attached is the high-level dataflow diagram; EdgeBridge has provided a pending SOC 2 Type II report (under NDA) — we can share the auditor letter and allow your security team to review under an NDA.

Rollback & migration window:
- Primary migration will be coordinated in a staged rollout by region.
- We will retain a legacy LogStream fallback for 72 hours post-cutover for quick rollback.
- There is no planned period of cross-border transfer outside the EEA for EU clients.

If these terms look OK, we will prepare a DocuSign envelope for the DPA amendment and share the final subprocessor roster. Would you like to schedule a review call with legal + security next Tue or Wed?

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: edgebridge-dataflow-diagram.pdf, dpa-amendment-draft.docx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 03 Jul 2029 16:30:00 +0000
Subject: Internal: Evidence items required from EdgeBridge (for CloudEdge review)

Team — collecting here the list we need to provide to CloudEdge so legal / privacy can sign off: 
- SOC 2 Type II (most recent), auditor letter, and scope (must include data handling & encryption controls)
- Copy of EdgeBridge subprocessor contracts with the SCCs clause visible
- Confirmation of EU-only processing (signed statement) and list of datacenter locations
- KMS integration docs showing customer key control and key rotation policy
- Dataflow diagram (we have a draft) and sample retention configs
- Contact for incident response + SLA addendum for three months post-migration

I'll add this to the vendor-evidence-checklist.xlsx and circulate to procurement for vendor onboarding packet. Marissa — can you confirm whether EdgeBridge will accept an SCC-based amendment and whether they will sign our standard subprocessor Addendum?

Thanks,
Kimberly
-----
Kimberly Park
Head of Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 04 Jul 2029 10:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Internal: Evidence items required from EdgeBridge (for CloudEdge review)

Kimberly / team — quick update from procurement/vetting: EdgeBridge has provided a scoped SOC 2 report (controls relevant to transit & logging) and agreed to SCCs. They confirm EU-only processing for CloudEdge accounts and support BYOK via a customer KMS integration.

Suggested next steps: 
1) Share the SOC 2 auditor letter and a redlined DPA amendment with CloudEdge under an NDA.
2) Schedule a 30-min call for Tue next week with EdgeBridge security lead.
3) Publish final subprocessor roster to the CloudEdge account page and send DocuSign for the DPA amendment.

Operational note: we will maintain the LogStream legacy pool as a fallback for 72 hours post-cutover and monitor for elevated error rates; rollback can be executed within 30 minutes if we observe retention mismatches.

Rishi
Procurement & Vendor Security
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

Attachment: vendor-evidence-checklist.xlsx

From: Donna Park <donna.park@cloudedge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: legal@cloudedge.com
Date: Fri, 05 Jul 2029 09:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Planned sunsetting of LogStream — subprocessor update & impact summary

Marissa — thanks for the details and the artifacts. We can provisionally approve the move to EdgeBridge provided: 
- We receive the SOC 2 auditor letter under NDA and the final DPA amendment signed via DocuSign prior to the migration window.
- CloudEdge gets visibility of the final subprocessor roster posted to the account and a one-hour runbook call with your ops team during cutover.

Please send the DocuSign link and the final roster. Legal has asked for the DPA amendment to include a 30-day written notice clause for any future subprocessor changes that affect data routing. Could you confirm acceptance?

I'll hold the go/no-go with our CISO until we receive the SOC 2 letter and the redlined DPA.

Thanks,
Donna
Head of Platform Security
CloudEdge Solutions

Attachments referenced: none
